empty.title: No API Keys
empty.description: API keys are not configured yet. Create your first API key to get started.

emptyState.title: API keys control access, budgets, and rate limits
emptyState.description: Create API keys to assign permissions, spending limits, and usage quotas to teams, customers, or API clients.

virtualKeyDetails.description: Virtual key details and usage information
virtualKeyDetails.noRateLimitsProvider: No rate limits configured for this provider

virtualKeySheet.createDescription: Create a new virtual key with specific permissions, budgets, and rate limits.
virtualKeySheet.editDescription: Update the virtual key configuration and permissions.
virtualKeySheet.managedByProfile: This virtual key is managed by an access profile. Only the name and description can be modified; providers, budgets, rate limits, and MCP access are controlled by the profile.
virtualKeySheet.providerConfigTooltip: Configure which providers this virtual key can use and their specific settings. Leave empty to block all providers. Add providers to allow them.
virtualKeySheet.mcpConfigTooltip: Configure which MCP clients this virtual key can use and their allowed tools. Leaving this section empty blocks all MCP tools. After adding an MCP client, you must select specific tools or choose Allow All Tools to grant tool access.
virtualKeySheet.selectMCPPlaceholder: Select an MCP client to add
virtualKeySheet.allowAllToolsDesc: Allow all current and future tools
virtualKeySheet.defaultMCPClients: The following MCP servers are available to this key by default with all tools enabled on that client: {{names}}. Adding an explicit config for any of them below will override the all-tools default for this key.
virtualKeySheet.budgetOverrideDesc: Add temporary capacity without changing the configured base budgets above.
virtualKeySheet.calendarAlignDesc: Reset budgets and rate limits at the start of each period (e.g. 1st of month) instead of rolling from creation date. Applies to durations of a day or longer.
virtualKeySheet.calendarAlignWarningDesc: Enabling calendar alignment will reset budget usage to $0.00 and token/request rate-limit counters to 0 for this virtual key, then snap each reset date to the start of its current period (e.g. start of day, week, month, or year). The usage reset cannot be undone, but calendar alignment can be turned off later. This will take effect when you save.
virtualKeySheet.rotateDesc: This will replace the secret value for "{{name}}". The key ID, budgets, rate limits, provider permissions, MCP access, and assignments stay the same. The previous key value will stop working immediately.
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetQuarterShiftTitle: Carry usage into the new quarter?
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetDesc: You changed a budget amount, reset frequency, or calendar alignment. Reset current budget usage to 0, or preserve the existing usage counters.
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetWarningSuffix: You can preserve usage anyway, or reset usage to 0.
virtualKeySheet.noPermission: You don't have permission to perform this action

budgetOverride.description: Temporarily add spending capacity without changing the base {{amount}} budget.
budgetOverride.forCycles: For a number of reset cycles
budgetOverride.firstCycleNote: The current reset cycle counts as the first cycle.

multiBudget.duplicateDuration: Duplicate reset period; each budget line must use a different interval.

budgetWarning.overLimit: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget has {{usage}} usage, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.
budgetWarning.quarterShift: {{scope}} quarterly budget has {{usage}} of usage. Changing the fiscal quarter moves the reset date and carries that spend into the new quarter.
budgetWarning.overLimitInherited: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget will inherit {{usage}} from the {{sourceDuration}} budget, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.

toast.mcpAlreadyConfigured: This MCP client is already configured

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage member accounts, role assignments, and offboarding flows.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by email or display name
users.empty: No users match the current filters.
users.noPermission: You do not have permission to view users.
users.disableConfirmDesc: User {{email}} will be blocked from signing in. Their VKs are not affected.
users.deleteConfirmDesc: User {{email}} will be permanently removed. This also disables their VKs.
users.resetTokenDesc: OSS has no email service; copy this token and send it to the member. They accept it via /invite/{token}.

memberPortal.title: Member Portal
memberPortal.noTeams: You are not a member of any team yet.
memberPortal.quickActionsHint: Submit key requests, view usage, and manage your subscriptions.
memberPortal.adminNote: You are also an admin. Visit /workspace/config/security for the admin surface.

memberKeys.title: My virtual keys
memberKeys.subtitle: These are the virtual keys your admin has assigned to you. Pick one to use as your API key — never share the underlying provider key.
memberKeys.empty: No virtual keys have been assigned to you yet.
memberKeys.emptyHint: Your team admin has not issued a key for your account. Ask them to create one or check back later.
memberKeys.usageHintDesc: Open the usage page for a monthly view of your consumption.
memberKeys.noTeamHint: You are not on any team yet — virtual keys come from a team assignment.

memberUsage.title: My usage
memberUsage.subtitle: Monthly view of your virtual-key consumption. Detailed per-VK histogram lands in a follow-up.
memberUsage.activeKeysHint: Virtual keys currently issued to you and not expired.
memberUsage.histogramHint: Token / cost breakdown lands when /api/logs/histogram is delegated to the member surface.
memberUsage.histogramPlaceholder: Detailed histogram is coming in a follow-up. For now, ask your admin for a usage breakdown.
memberUsage.detailDesc: Detailed monthly usage lives in the admin governance view. As a member you see only the keys you own.
memberUsage.detailFootnote: Phase-2 only ships the active-key count + last login. The histogram endpoint is tracked as a follow-up so this page does not need a second migration when it lands.

memberSetupGuide.title: Setup guide
memberSetupGuide.subtitle: Five minutes from this page to a working request. The endpoint never carries provider credentials — only your virtual keys.
memberSetupGuide.step1Desc: Use this base URL with any OpenAI-compatible SDK.
memberSetupGuide.compatibleHint: compatible — drop-in for the OpenAI SDK / Anthropic-Bedrock-style SDKs.
memberSetupGuide.step2Desc: Use one of these IDs as your Authorization: Bearer <value>. Your admin gave you the matching secret value out-of-band.
memberSetupGuide.noKeys: You do not have any active virtual keys yet. Ask your admin to issue one before continuing.
memberSetupGuide.step3Desc: Replace <your_vk_value> with the secret value your admin shared. Replace the model id with one you are allowed to use.
memberSetupGuide.docsDesc: Full reference for the gateway plus SDK snippets in Python, JavaScript, and curl.
memberSetupGuide.adminHint: You are also an admin — the gateway docs live in this repo.

memberLogin.title: Member sign-in
memberLogin.subtitle: Sign in with the email that was invited to your team.

userDetail.vksDesc: Virtual keys owned by this user. Provider-key secrets are never shown here.
userDetail.disableVksDesc: Disable every active virtual key owned by {{email}}? Provider keys are not affected. ({{count}} VKs will be disabled.)
userDetail.notFoundDesc: The requested user does not exist or has been removed.

alerting.title: Alerting
alerting.subtitle: Configure alert rules, route events to webhooks / Slack / SMTP, and review firing history.
alerting.empty: No alert rules match the current filters.
alerting.emptyCardTitle: Alert rules are how the gateway surfaces cost spikes and error spikes.
alerting.emptyCardDesc: Click Create rule to add one. Each rule binds a metric (e.g. cost per minute) to a scope (global / team / VK) and one or more delivery channels.
alerting.deleteConfirmDesc: Rule "{{name}}" will be removed and stop generating events. Existing events are kept for audit.
alerting.sheetDesc: Each rule binds one metric to one scope. Delivery channels may be webhook, Slack, or SMTP.
alerting.validationOneChannel: At least one channel is required.
alerting.noEvents: No events have been recorded for this rule yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Inspect pricing books, gateway profitability, and reconciliation status.
reports.standardPricesDesc: Override the actual-side datasheet with internal mark-ups. Each row carries an effective_from so historical windows pick the right snapshot.
reports.gatewayDeltaDesc: Compare the gateway's billed spend against the standard price book for any window. Negative deltas are gateway losses; positive deltas are margin.

standardPrices.title: Standard prices
standardPrices.subtitle: Internal price book used by gateway-delta and team reconciliation reports.
standardPrices.sheetDesc: Input and output costs are per 1M tokens. Cache-read and cost-per-request are optional.
standardPrices.deleteConfirmDesc: Remove {{provider}}/{{model}} from the standard price book. Historical reports keep using the snapshot they pinned at the time.

toast.synced: Synced {{count}} rows from the actual-side datasheet.

standardPrices.empty: No standard-price rows. Run Sync to seed from the actual-side datasheet, or click New price to add one.

gatewayDelta.title: Gateway delta
gatewayDelta.subtitle: Actual vs. standard cost across providers and models.
gatewayDelta.coverageDesc: Share of actual spend that the standard price book can explain.

teams.noMembers: No team members yet. Send an invitation to add one.
teams.inviteSheetDesc: An invitation token is valid for 7 days. OSS has no email service, so copy the generated link and send it manually.
teams.revokeConfirmDesc: The recipient will no longer be able to accept this invitation. The row is kept for audit.
teams.inviteLinkDesc: Copy the token below and send the link to the recipient. They will land on /invite/{token} to accept.

teamPolicies.title: Model policies
teamPolicies.subtitle: Per-provider model ACL
teamPolicies.subtitleDesc: When set, the resolver narrows VK allowlists to the union of these lists. Team-wide rules apply to every VK under this team.
teamPolicies.empty: No per-provider policy set yet. VKs will fall back to their own allowlist.
teamPolicies.d6Hint: Hint: leaving "Allowed models" empty denies every model of that provider (deny-by-default). If you only want to blacklist specific models, also fill in "*" or list the allowed models explicitly.
teamPolicies.d6AutoFillWarning: Only blacklisted models were set; "allowed_models" was auto-filled with ["*"] so the blacklist works as intended. Edit the row to override.
teamPolicies.allowedPlaceholder: comma-separated, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o or * for all
